scope: Full fpqc-stackified framed Artin completion at a smooth complex cubic: arbitrary flat-cover line reconstruction, unipotent scalar Amitsur correction, effective descent of section Hom and composition, exact transition compatibility, and direct vanishing of framed automorphisms. Previous envelope, quantization/formal-ring and four-parameter relative results retained. New proofs independently read by collaborating agents; no external peer review or full re-audit of all older results.

review.definition: All exact O-preserving equivalences are retained. The full fpqc-stackified framed Artin completion at a smooth cubic is now equivalent to all flat Abelian deformations; nonnoetherian covers are handled in big QGr using the original Artin coefficient map. This does not assert general category 2-descent or a finite-type atlas.
review.relative_veronese: Complete proof checked, including universal polynomial embedding, Cech intersection from P-flatness, nonreduced-base conic lifting, mu2 Isom torsor, grading-scalar sheaf quotient, and H1 versus H2 descent. An independent reading found no substantive error; section reconstruction on the conic was made explicit.
review.pointed_hom: The original C1-C4 theorem is retained. A compact version of C3 is proved and used for the whole finite-order four-parameter family: D(QGr)^c equals local Perf by BDG Thm3.14; all exact Abelian equivalences preserve it. Full relative Serre and Hom comparison hold over every finite-type complex base, including singular and nonreduced fibres. The original finite-base-Tor C3 still agrees only on the separately constructed nonempty open.
review.formal_cubic: DDL all-Artin comparison and O-marking classical 1-groupoid convention retained. Lowen Thms3.14/3.26, Yekutieli Cors7.5/11.2, and objectwise unique lifts independently checked against original sources. The main full-Abel envelope theorem uses constructed-family surjectivity directly, not prior periodicity or the stronger central-pair injectivity theorem.
review.envelope_reduction: All-degree envelope flatness is now proved for every flat Abelian Artin deformation of a smooth complex cubic threefold. Consequently the retained normal-regular cubic kernel and relative Koszul-AS5 proofs apply. This is relative AS over possibly singular Artin bases, not absolute global dimension five.
review.degree_three_obstruction: B3=R^34 direct_sum R/I and I=Fitt_34(B3) retained. Complete nilpotent sorting proof establishes degree-three flatness iff all-degree flatness for nonperiodic quadratic Z-algebras with polynomial special fibre. Independently reviewed. General Koszul deformation principle is established literature, PP Ch6 Thm7.3, not claimed new.
review.rigid_ambient_application: The retained PBW, AS5, CY and Aut_gr(B_*)(C)=C* inputs are explicit. Cartier characteristic-zero smoothness upgrades the finite-type automorphism group scheme to Gm. Quadratic envelope and leading gamma coefficient then prove arbitrary-coefficient graded isomorphism iff f=g. Compact relative Hom and fixed-family fpqc Hom descent give a monomorphism A4→M^O on finite-type complex tests. No open immersion, atlas or component assertion.
review.retained_results: Existing 41/37 and17/13 constructions, gcd periodicity, all-Artin envelope, square-zero obstruction and formal-ring proofs retained. New universal coefficient, finite central, Serre and full-family relative comparison proofs were reviewed. The complete older PBW/CY/rigid calculation proofs were not newly reconstructed, and unchanged calculations were not rerun.
review.novelty: DDL/Lowen/Yekutieli/CFT/Koszul, ordinary Amitsur/module descent and prior duality inputs are established literature. Novelty/priority of the specific full cubic formal stack application, direct automorphism argument, and retained four-parameter comparison remain unconfirmed.
review.square_zero_obstruction: Complete proof independently reviewed: Schur residual Theta=delta(q_(i+1)-q_i)=F lambda; delta^2=0 and injectivity on constant three-cochains force lambda=0. Valid for any nonzero cubic, no smoothness, with dim V>=4; written in five-variable case. General Artin I subset m^2 follows by Fitting base change. Nonlinear Jacobi corrections prevent naive higher-order induction.
review.homogeneous_quantization: CFT arXiv:math/0012228v3 §3, Thm3.1, Prop3.3 and Cor5.2(iv) checked. Finite nilpotent substitution, graph-degree preservation, alpha=Pi/2 normalization, quadraticity via split-kernel Nakayama, and central cubic regularity supplied explicitly. Full graded Hochschild/Poisson gauge classification is not assumed.
review.actual_artin_comparison: Relative Poisson functor is prorepresented by T, using lifted polarization, relative bivector/Jacobi calculations and the formal PGL slice; H0(T_X)=0 removes infinitesimal automorphisms. Yekutieli makes Ass represented by the same T. The actual constructed map has injective 20-dimensional tangent map, hence induces an invertible continuous endomorphism of T. No higher agreement of independent quantization coordinates is assumed.
review.central_pair_comparison: Construction proves surjectivity of actual central-pair-to-Ass map. Injectivity uses unique invertible bimodule polarization, section recovery and quadratic envelope. Framed ring is formal PGL24 torsor over T, with scalar stabilizer removed. Proof reordered to avoid circular dependence on graded formality classification.
review.universal_coefficients: Direct Gabriel localization for arbitrary commutative S; tails torsion verified localizing using finite degree-one generation. Flat-object Ext1 reduction, finite-length induction and fp-source filtered-colimit Hom prove universal saturation. No finite-S/noetherian-S hypothesis is hidden in this argument; small qgr is used only where Abelian.
review.coefficient_descent: Internal faithfully flat descent checked via Lazard, purity/conservativity and coaction equalizer. Exact equivalences extend uniquely by adjoint mates. Hom groupoids retain natural isomorphisms; only O-marked trivial-2-inertia models permit the stated descent after passing to isomorphism classes. Full category 2-descent is not claimed.
review.canonical_relative_formal: Canonical coefficient families and all O-marked Abel deformations remain equivalent. The new full stack comparison constructs a global canonical model for every stackified framed Artin object by scalar cocycle correction and ordinary section-algebra descent.
review.universal_line_cohomology: Finite flat Ore Cech complexes commute arbitrary scalar tensor. Small-extension five-lemma proves finite free cohomology: H0 for n>=0, none for n=-1, H3 of rank h(-n-2) for n<=-2. Locally projective line objects give perfect RHom with arbitrary derived base change. This is a proof, not a numerical experiment.
review.finite_central_model: Rains Thm2.13 hypotheses checked. Reduced finite-type constant-rank commutator kernels lift central symbols; homogeneous lifts give finite graded central C. Arbitrary base change uses C_S as a central action, without claiming its injectivity or full-center base-change equality. Degree-one A makes positive-central localizations strongly graded; finite sheaf-algebra Proj model and C1 established.
review.central_universal_sections: Noetherian coefficients: regular central u^ell,v^ell give H0/H1 local-cohomology vanishing. Arbitrary coefficients: write S as filtered colimit of finite-type P-subalgebras, use fp standard objects, arbitrary coefficient Gabriel equivalence and free-action adjunction. All-shift saturation is universal. Even reconstruction and functor determination retain their noetherian finite-presentation argument.
review.intrinsic_perfect_open: Coherent Ext localizes to all central affine charts via twist resolutions, finite Cech and filtered colimits; fg syzygy plus Baer gives chart gldim from geometric-generic tails regularity. RSV finite-central PI smoothness and direct splitting-denominator spread yield relative perfect diagonals on a nonempty base open. Diagonal resolutions imply finite base-Tor equals locally Perf after arbitrary noetherian base change. Global dg Morita smoothness is not asserted.
review.relative_rhom: For the finite-central family, local A-perfect Hom is ambient O_Z-perfect after the projective embedding. Stacks0B91 supplies perfect global RHom and arbitrary derived coefficient base change. This underlies the new relative Serre theorem. Nonflat central Proj is allowed; ordinary O_Y-derived pullback is not substituted.
review.universal_degree_two_center: For the concrete B_* family, the rank12 commutator map is injective at every closed coefficient point by the retained low-center lemmas. Jacobsonness makes the rank open all of Spec P; split injectivity survives every commutative coefficient base change, including nonnoetherian rings. Full-center base change is not asserted.
review.field_bimodule_duality: Yekutieli1992 Prop5.2, direct balanced check via torsion of injectives, and bimodule uniqueness identify RHom_T(A,R_T) with R_A. Exact Veronese plus graded injective localization gives projective ambient dual E_-2[3] as bimodule, with shift [-1]. B_k noetherianity is proved through the finite-central f=0 quotient and positive-degree central extension; no automatic field-extension noetherianity. RRZ Nakayama/AS-index relation and central cubic quotient give untwisted R_A=A(-2)[4] under retained B_* inputs.
review.relative_serre: Construct D_P=RHom_OZ(j_*A,omega[N]) over regular P=C[a,b,c,d]. Finite ambient perfect resolutions and A P-flatness give underlying ambient base change compatible with both actions. Stacks00MI gives D=W[3] with W P-flat. Stacks07VK and RΓ(A_s)=k(s) give evaluation line L, Pic(P)=0 gives a right isomorphism, and generic bimodule identity plus P-torsionfree W proves left linearity. Taking H^-3 after coefficient base change gives strict bimodule W⊗S, without an enveloping-algebra flatness assumption. Tensor-Hom and projective Groth trace give natural Serre (-2)[3] with arbitrary noetherian base change. No generic regularity needed.
review.compact_serre_normalization: BDG Defs3.1/3.13 and Thm3.14 checked. Exact equivalences extend to standard unbounded dg enhancements, preserve coproducts/K-injectives and compact objects. All line objects are locally projective and compact. Choice differences are scalar on the line sequence by faithful adjacent Hom; no claim that all transformations on the entire perfect category are scalar.
review.full_stackified_hom: Fixed canonical families have arbitrary fpqc Hom descent, including non-finite-type covers; pointed trivial 2-inertia upgrades representatives to coherent actual transitions. This input is now also used to construct global objects in the framed Artin completion at a smooth cubic. General effective descent of arbitrary category families is not asserted.
review.flat_cover_reconstruction: DDL Thm4.5 applied to original coherent R→C and the C-linear category QCoh(X_{S/mS}); no coherent/noetherian S assumption. Flatness of tails over R follows via injective/coflat criterion and exact Gabriel quotient. R-flat finite m-filtration proves S-free section Hom; representable images then give S-flat line objects. Universal Hom/Ext1 uses finite mS-filtration, and all-q Ext reduction + finite affine Cech gives finite presentation. Companions and primary hypotheses independently reviewed.
review.unipotent_amitsur_descent: Actual framed overlaps yield defects in 1+m S^(tensor3), not full Gm. Finite log/exp identifies the cosimplicial group with m tensor S^(tensor•); Stacks023M exactness kills the defects. E0 retains its original marking. Finite-projective Hom and composition descend by023N/058S; DDL plus retained cubic envelope/universal admissibility then gives global model. Componentwise section Hom naturality identifies actual transitions. No Brauer-vanishing or general category-descent premise.
review.framed_automorphisms: Direct section derivation proof: quadratic commutativity forces adjacent derivations to differ by scalars; vertex scalars normalized at0 reduce to one M; D_M(F) in CF, Euler subtraction and regular quadratic gradient Koszul syzygies force M scalar. Small-extension induction mJ=0 aligns line comparisons via units, kills the inner derivation and extends marked natural isomorphism via section Hom. Independently audited. No additional general HH1 control theorem assumed.
review.full_discrete_formal_ring: All framed automorphism classes vanish, so the full stackified framed Artin groupoid is equivalent to its discrete pi0, represented noncanonically by the retained20-variable/five-Pfaffian ring of dimension17. Unframed Aut(X), unrestricted2-groupoids, algebraization and atlas claims excluded. Explicit nonliftable epsilon bivector and non-complete-intersection consequence proved, without numerical testing.
